title: setup-tool tool manifest
description: Files that setup-tool copies into $HOME for one tool.

destinationRoot.description: Base folder for relative destinations. Expanded by pwsh on Windows and bash elsewhere, e.g. $HOME/.pi.

platform.description: Where the file applies; also the source folder next to this manifest (without "group:"). common: everywhere; group:posix: macOS, Linux, and WSL; group:linux: Linux and WSL; macos, wsl, windows: only that system.

source.description: Path inside the platform folder, e.g. agent/settings.json; a folder when recursive is true.

destination.description: Where to copy the file (or folder when recursive is true). Expanded by pwsh on Windows and bash elsewhere (e.g. $env:APPDATA/..., $HOME/...); an absolute result is used as is, otherwise it is relative to destinationRoot.

recursive.description: Treat source and destination as folders and sync every file under source. setup-tool errors if source is a folder without this, or not a folder with it.
